title: 第66章七玄门紧迫感第65章 遇玄风
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: 见陈安油盐不进，李玄风不禁莞尔，似乎觉得这家伙的戒备有些可笑。
他也不再废话，随手从袖中取出一枚通体温润的玉牌。
玉牌之上，七颗星辰的纹路清晰可见，散发着微光。
“我名李玄风，乃七玄门弟子。”
七玄门？
陈安不由得一愣，他还从来没有听说过七玄门这个名字。
只是陈安也知晓，在大乾王朝这样一个封建王朝之中，还能够成立的势力，绝对不简单。
或许是看穿了陈安的想法，李玄风再度开口。
“想来你这等坐井观天的武夫，也不知晓外界天地之广阔。”
“大乾王朝分九郡，你所在的雷云县，不过是云州郡下辖百县中最不起眼的一个。”
李玄风的声音在寂静的夜里回荡。
“而在整个云州郡，真正主宰一切的，并非朝廷，而是我七玄门、天刀阁、万毒谷这三大上宗。”
“所谓的县令，所谓的八品武者，在我等眼中，与蝼蚁无异。”
陈安的心头微微一震。
三大上宗……
李玄风收回玉牌，目光落在陈安身上。
“我来此，只为追查白巾军余孽。你这等地方草莽的争斗，我没兴趣理会。”
“只是你的气血雄浑，倒也比起雷云县其他的武者要强。”
“只是现在看来……一般！”
话音未落，他的身影竟如一缕青烟，在原地缓缓消散，仿佛从未出现过。
独留陈安一人立于血腥的庭院中，许久，他才深吸一口气，压下心中的惊涛骇浪。
七玄门、云州郡、三大上宗……
还有李玄风的评价。
要知道，陈安以金刚不坏身突破的九品炼脏圆满，气血强度比起同境界的武者来说要强悍许多。
最重要的是……
自己的根骨已然达到了100点，进化成了武骨。
不说堪比初入八品的武者，至少八品之下，陈安敢说无敌。
可是在李玄风的口中，竟然成了一般。
“上宗弟子么？”
陈安看着李玄风离开的方向，不由得握紧了拳头。
小小的雷云县，这段时间发生的事情，让陈安多少有些头疼了。
content_en:
Seeing that Chen An was not getting enough, Li Xuanfeng couldn't help but smile, seeming to find this guy's caution a bit ridiculous.
He stopped talking nonsense and took out a jade token from his sleeve that was moist all over.
On the jade tablet, the lines of seven stars are clearly visible, emitting a faint light.
"My name is Li Xuanfeng, and I am a disciple of Qixuanmen."
Qixuanmen?
Chen An couldn't help but be stunned. He had never heard of the name Qixuanmen before.
But Chen An also knew that in a feudal dynasty like the Daqian Dynasty, the power that could still be established was definitely not simple.
Perhaps seeing through Chen An's thoughts, Li Xuanfeng spoke again.
"I think warriors like you, who sit in a well and look at the sky, don't know the vastness of the outside world."
"The Daqian Dynasty was divided into nine counties. Leiyun County where you are located is just the most inconspicuous of the hundreds of counties under the jurisdiction of Yunzhou County."
Li Xuanfeng's voice echoed in the silent night.
"And in the entire Yunzhou County, the one who really dominates everything is not the imperial court, but our three great sects, Qixuan Sect, Tiandao Pavilion, and Ten Thousand Poison Valley."
"The so-called county magistrate and the so-called eighth-grade warrior are no different from ants in our eyes."
Chen An's heart was slightly shaken.
The three great sects...
Li Xuanfeng took back the jade token and looked at Chen An.
"I am here only to track down the remnants of the White Turban Army. I have no interest in the reckless fighting in places like yours."
"It's just that your Qi and blood are strong, which is stronger than other warriors in Leiyun County."
"It just seems... average now!"
Before he finished speaking, his figure was like a wisp of smoke, slowly dissipating on the spot, as if he had never appeared before.
Chen An was left alone in the bloody courtyard. After a long time, he took a deep breath and suppressed the turmoil in his heart.
Qixuanmen, Yunzhou County, the three great sects...
There is also Li Xuanfeng’s evaluation.
You must know that Chen An's ninth level Zang Refining Perfection, which he broke through with the Vajra Indestructible Body, has a much stronger energy and blood intensity than those of warriors at the same level.
The most important thing is...
His root bone has reached 100 points and evolved into a martial bone.
Not to mention being comparable to a warrior who has just entered the eighth level, at least below the eighth level, Chen An dares to say that he is invincible.
But in Li Xuanfeng's mouth, it turned out to be ordinary.
"A disciple of the Shang Sect?"
Chen An looked at the direction Li Xuanfeng left and couldn't help clenching his fists.
In the small Leiyun County, what happened during this period gave Chen An a bit of a headache.
title_en: Chapter 66 The sense of urgency of Qixuanmen Chapter 65 Meeting Xuanfeng
